note: Ashley NF campground on a sagebrush bench above the far northeast shore of Flaming Gorge Reservoir, about 10 mi west of US-191 on FR 106, beside a boat ramp and a day-use swim beach. Little shade; red-rock bluffs around. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + FS current. $33 (2026/2027), 36 nonelectric sites (19 reservable, 17 FCFS), all 35 ft, paired shared pads; flush toilets, showers, water, dump (fee). 2027 season 05-15..09-15. 16-night max, 4-day cutoff, senior discount single sites. Lakeview CONFIRMED (nearest sites ~55-75 m from the water with a bluff and a dirt track between). Pin ~130 m S of loop centre, fine. Phone empty -> 801-226-3564.
flags: WATERFRONT 'lakeview' STANDS (checked hard): the single loop sits on an open sagebrush bench; the northernmost sites 022 (41.35141,-109.44452), 021, 025 face the reservoir. On Esri imagery 022 is ~45 m from the top of the shoreline bluff and ~60 m from the water, 025 ~75 m; a dirt two-track runs along the bench between the loop and the bluff, and the shore is a low rock bluff, not open ground to the water. Over ~50 m with a track and a bluff between = view, not lakefront. Nothing blocks the view (no trees); rec.gov: 'The site affords scenic views of the reservoir'.

SHARED PADS: FS 'The campsites feature a shared pad designed to accommodate two separate sites' - a single site holds one sleeping unit (rec.gov 'There is not room for 2 sleeping units'); a 23-ft rig fits the 35-ft spurs.
PHONE: empty -> 801-226-3564 (concessionaire American Land & Leisure, rec.gov notice).
FEES: $33 (rec.gov) matches; the $64 rate line is a double site.
PIN: stored 41.34969,-109.44613 is at the loop entrance by site 001, ~130 m from the loop centre (41.3506,-109.4451); no move needed.
Websites current: FS r04 page 200; rec.gov 231904 listed.
